entry.title: Daily Digest — 2026-11-10
entry.summary: On the House floor, the digest records two roll-call votes: Roll Call No. 315 passed H.R. 3978, which amends the Atomic Energy Act's definition of production facility, by 397 to 2, and Roll Call No. 316 passed H.R. 9612, the American Enrichment Deployment Act, by 394 to 3, both under suspension of the rules.
